description: Pseudoephedrine, taken the way the box intends. Opens the sinuses, sharpens the edges, and keeps you upright about an hour past where you should have stopped.

effects.onset_message: Your head clears. You can breathe through both sides of your nose, which is more than most people here can say.

overdose.message: It was a cold remedy and you ate it like sweets. Your pulse goes thin and fast and then it doesn't go at all.

phases.comedown_message: The lift drains out and leaves you gritty-eyed.
phases.end_message: You are simply tired now, and your nose is blocked again.

name: pseudoephedrine
